inlines.v: R'ASP, noun [See Rase.] 1. A large rough file; a grater. 2. A raspberry, which see. R'ASP, verb transitive [See Rase.] To rub or file with a rasp; to rub or grate with a rough file; as, to rasp wood to make it smooth; to rasp bones to powder.
